summary: refactor(coru-http): address shotgun surgery on instance variable

delivery.outcome: Shotgun surgery on 'instance' removed: dispatchers pass the lane instance as a kwarg via _lane_instance_from_suffix; body parsing is centralized in _body_instance.
nonGoals: Changing routes, status codes or response payloads

architecture.decision: Dispatchers no longer bind a local 'instance'; _lane_instance_from_suffix handles /api/lanes/<id><suffix> extraction (empty suffix for delete), _body_instance centralizes body parsing.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket branch; pure function-level refactor in one module.

validation.evidence: Supervisor HTTP routes and lane handlers behave identically.
